symbol_fetch_failing.title: {symbol} price updates are failing ({portfolio})
symbol_fetch_failing.description: Home Assistant hasn't been able to fetch a price for {symbol} in the '{portfolio}' portfolio for several update cycles in a row. This usually means Yahoo Finance is rate-limiting requests, the symbol is wrong or delisted, or there's a network issue. Check the symbol under Configure, or wait a while if this looks like a temporary outage.
